北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗，气温 31℃，体感 32℃，记得防晒补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and 31℃. Stay hydrated and use sun protection!

广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and 34℃, feels like 38℃! It's scorching, please hydrate and use sunscreen.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗 33℃，体感 38℃。小心高温中暑，多补充水分！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and 33℃, feels like 38℃. Watch out for heatstroke, drink plenty!
